declaration.accept: I have read the declaration above, I accept it in full, and I understand that it must be renewed annually with re-certification.

clauses.c1: I will treat every health worker with dignity and respect, and will acknowledge the conditions in which they work.
clauses.c10: I will intervene immediately if I observe care that places a child at risk of serious harm, notwithstanding the rule that I observe silently, and will record the intervention in the visit report.
clauses.c11: I will comply with the Federal Ministry of Health code of conduct and with the standards on the prevention of sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment (PSEAH) of the Ministry and of any supporting partner.
clauses.c12: I will report any safeguarding concern through the designated reporting channel and will not attempt to resolve it informally at facility level.
clauses.c13: I will not solicit or accept any payment, gift or favor from a facility, a health worker or a caregiver in connection with my role.
clauses.c14: I will record findings accurately, including findings that reflect poorly on the program, and will not enter data I have not personally observed.
clauses.c15: I will follow the security and access provisions in Chapter 5, and will not conduct a visit that diverts staff or transport from urgent clinical need.
clauses.c2: I will be supportive rather than inspectorial. My role is to help health workers improve, not to catch them making mistakes.
clauses.c3: I will give feedback privately, specifically and constructively, and never in front of caregivers, patients or other staff.
clauses.c4: I will not use assessment scores for disciplinary purposes, performance appraisal, promotion decisions or redeployment, and I will say so to every mentee at the first visit.
clauses.c5: I will explain to caregivers who I am and why I am present, will seek their agreement before observing a consultation, and will accept a refusal without any consequence for the child's care.
clauses.c6: I will not record patient names or other patient identifiers on any mentorship tool, and will not transmit patient information over messaging platforms.
clauses.c7: I will keep mentee assessment results confidential to the mentee, myself and the program.
clauses.c8: I will never examine a child or remain alone with a child. A caregiver and the mentee will be present at all times.
clauses.c9: I will not photograph patients or caregivers. Photographs are of the facility only.

treatments.soothe_throat_cough: Soothe the throat and relieve the cough with a safe remedy.
treatments.cough_14_days_refer: If coughing for 14 days or more refer for assessment.
treatments.return_immediately: Advise mother when to return immediately.
treatments.follow_up_5_days: Follow up in 5 days if not improving.
treatments.plan_c: Give fluid for severe dehydration (Plan C)
treatments.continue_breastfeeding: Advise the mother to continue breastfeeding.
treatments.cholera_antibiotic: If child is 2 years or older and there is cholera in your area, give antibiotic for cholera.
treatments.plan_b: Give fluid for some dehydration (Plan B)
treatments.plan_a_50_100: Give fluid and food to treat diarrhea at home (Plan A): 50-100 ml after loose stool
treatments.plan_a_100_200: Give fluid and food to treat diarrhea at home (Plan A): 100-200 ml after loose stool
treatments.zinc_10mg: Give Zinc: 10 mg (1/2 tab) x 14 days
treatments.zinc_20mg: Give Zinc: 20 mg (1 tab) x 14 days
treatments.cipro_3days: Give an oral ciprofloxacin for 3 days.
treatments.treat_dehydration_before_referral: Treat dehydration before referral unless the child has another severe classification.
treatments.advise_feeding_persistent_diarrhea: Advise the mother on feeding a child who has PERSISTENT DIARRHOEA.
treatments.assess_other_fever: Assess for other cause of fever and treat accordingly.
treatments.fever_7_days_refer: If fever for 7 days or more refer for assessment
treatments.follow_up_fever_3_days: Follow-up in 3 days if fever persist.
treatments.coartem_first_line: Give first line of oral antimalarial (Coartem).
treatments.primaquine_vivax: In case of Vivax give primaquine after completion of the first line antimalaria
treatments.tetracycline_eye: If clouding of the cornea or pus draining from the eye, apply tetracycline eye ointment.
treatments.tetracycline_pus: If pus draining from the eye, treat eye infection with tetracycline eye ointment.
treatments.gentian_violet_mouth: If mouth ulcers, treat with gentian violet.
treatments.advise_feed_child: Advise the mother to feed the child.
treatments.paracetamol_pain: Give first dose of paracetamol for pain
treatments.refer_hearing_problem: Refer for assessment if there is hearing problems
treatments.mebendazole_dose: Give mebendazole if child is 1 year or older and has not received dose in the last 6 months
treatments.assess_feeding_less_2yrs: If child is less than 2 years old, assess the child's feeding and counsel the mother on feeding according to the feeding recommendations.
treatments.refer_otp_rutf: Refer for Outpatient Therapeutic Program (OTP) for ready-to-use therapeutic food (RUTF) if a child aged 6 months or more.
treatments.counsel_feed_child: Counsel the mother on how to feed the child.
treatments.refer_supplementary_feeding: Refer for the child for Supplementary feeding program if available.
treatments.assess_feeding_growth_monitoring: Assess the child's feeding and counsel the mother on the feeding recommendations and refer for growth monitoring and health promotion.
treatments.follow_up_feeding_7_days: If feeding problem, follow up in 7 days.
treatments.counsel_feeding_mother_card: Counsel on feeding problem using mother card
treatments.praise_mother_feeding: Praise the mother for feeding the child well
treatments.give_paracetamol_high_fever: Give one dose of paracetamol in clinic for high fever (38.5° or above)
